name: Ixalan
description: Ixalan is a plane with a verdant jungle continent, home to Huatli and the forgotten city of Orazca, where all peoples sought the Immortal Sun.

summary.text: Ixalan is a plane with a verdant jungle continent, home to Huatli and the forgotten city of Orazca, where all peoples sought the Immortal Sun.

bio.text: The Immortal Sun passed from legend to reality, and all the peoples of Ixalan sought its power.
Orazca is the forgotten city on the continent to which Vraska was sent.
Huatli was trapped on her home plane for many years by a magical artifact, and Jace realized that a hidden spell had compelled him to planeswalk to Ixalan.
When the Immortal Sun was pulled away, Vraska planeswalked off Ixalan, and Tishana declared Orazca found and the plane at peace.

status.text: The latest event in the material shows Ixalan declared at peace after the Immortal Sun's departure, with later pages describing Saheeli stranded there.

timeline.summary: Months later Vraska captains The Belligerent, and the compass directs her crew south.
timeline.quote: Set course due south,

timeline.summary: The crew spots a castaway on a seastack and Vraska recognizes Jace Beleren, resolving to petrify him.
timeline.quote: It was Jace Beleren.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees Jace is emaciated and ill, drops her petrifying gaze and asks what happened to him.
timeline.quote: Vraska snuffed the fire in her mind and looked down at him with no magic in her eyes.

timeline.summary: A Legion of Dusk ship appears and Vraska recalls an earlier attack and the vampires' pursuit of the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: The Immortal Sun was stolen from their monasteries

timeline.summary: Vraska orders an attack; Jace camouflages the ship and she silences it with an assassin's spell as they approach.
timeline.quote: The Belligerent was now imperceptible to any outside its rails.

timeline.summary: The crew boards the vampire ship and takes it by surprise.
timeline.quote: The vampires were caught completely off guard.

timeline.summary: Vraska fights the vampire captain with Jace's illusion clones and petrifies him when he grabs Jace.
timeline.quote: The vampire's skin and clothes turned to stone in her grip.

timeline.summary: Jace is amazed rather than afraid at Vraska's gorgon power and thanks her, calling her talented.
timeline.quote: Jace was not afraid. He was amazed.

timeline.summary: Tishana catches up with Kumena on the coast, where he conjures storms against approaching ships, and she overpowers his spell.
timeline.quote: I subsume his spell with magic of mine own.

timeline.summary: Tishana rams a ship into a sea stack and exchanges barbs with Kumena before he punches her and knocks her out.
timeline.quote: I look over my shoulder just in time to see Kumena's fist hit my face.

timeline.summary: A storm and a Legion of Dusk ship converge as the ship nears Ixalan, and Vraska orders abandon ship.
timeline.quote: Jace saw the Legion of Dusk ship coasting atop the water.

timeline.summary: A wave sweeps Jace and Vraska off the deck and The Belligerent rams into the rocks.
timeline.quote: And The Belligerent rammed into the rocks.

timeline.summary: Vona's ship closes on the Belligerent, hoping to board and feed on its crew.
timeline.quote: Boarding the pirate ship was ironic, but necessary to keep her sated.

timeline.summary: A conjured storm tosses Vona's ship, which rams into a sea stack and wrecks on the shore.
timeline.quote: just as her ship rammed into the side of the sea stack

timeline.summary: Vona kills and drinks from an injured pirate, declaring him guilty of deceit.
timeline.quote: I find you guilty of deceit, and a criminal in the eyes of the Church.

timeline.summary: Vona marches into the jungle alone, intent on taking the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: She was the Butcher of Magan, and the Immortal Sun was hers for the taking.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska, who leapt overboard in the storm, swim ashore.
timeline.quote: he had leapt overboard alongside Vraska.

timeline.summary: Jace puts a charging vampire to sleep with his mind magic.
timeline.quote: The vampire in front of him stumbled in the sand and collapsed to the ground, snoring.

timeline.summary: Vraska petrifies another vampire with her gaze, warning Jace to close his eyes.
timeline.quote: A petrified vampire lay at his feet.

timeline.summary: Vraska reports that the crew has lost Edgar.
timeline.quote: We lost Edgar

timeline.summary: Breeches volunteers the crew to fight the Legion of Dusk while Vraska and Jace seek the Sun, to be tracked by Jace's illusion.
timeline.quote: We fight Dusk, you find Sun! Meet up later!

timeline.summary: Vraska orders the crew to leave the locals alone but kill every vampire.
timeline.quote: kill every vampire you find.

timeline.summary: Jace veils himself and Vraska in invisibility and hides their footprints as they flee upriver in the dinghy.
timeline.quote: He shut his eyes and dutifully willed a veil of invisibility over himself and Vraska.

timeline.summary: Vraska reveals to Jace that neither is from Ixalan and that she is a planeswalker, planeswalking in front of him.
timeline.quote: We're Planeswalkers.

timeline.summary: Vraska theorizes that Orazca holds the enchantment that stops them from leaving the plane.
timeline.quote: I believe that Orazca doesn't just contain the Immortal Sun.

timeline.summary: Jace works out that the compass points to blooms of powerful magic and aetheric north, which is why it pointed to him.
timeline.quote: We thought the compass was just pointing to the city, but it points to blooms of powerful magic.

timeline.summary: Vraska apologizes for hiding her planeswalking and thanks Jace for listening to her story.
timeline.quote: No one has ever listened to my story like you did. Thank you.

timeline.summary: Jace senses people nearby, including a minotaur.
timeline.quote: One human, one vampire, a merfolk . . . and a minotaur.

timeline.summary: Huatli and her riders search the beach for a River Herald who could guide her to the Golden City.
timeline.quote: This is where she would find her guide to lead her to the Golden City.

timeline.summary: Huatli glimpses Vraska among the wrecked ships.
timeline.quote: Her skin was emerald green, more reptilian than anything else

timeline.summary: Huatli finds the unconscious Tishana on a rock and wakes her.
timeline.quote: There, lying on the rock overlooking the vast, unending ocean, was an unconscious female merfolk.

timeline.summary: Tishana tells Huatli that a River Herald, Kumena, has betrayed her cause and is heading to Orazca.
timeline.quote: A River Herald has betrayed my cause and is traveling there now.

timeline.summary: Huatli kneels and swears she means no claim on Orazca, and Tishana agrees to guide her, warning she will kill her if she tries to claim it.
timeline.quote: We are not each other's enemy.

timeline.summary: Tishana senses that Huatli really did see the city and gives her the terms of the alliance.
timeline.quote: If you say you saw a city when you skimmed the edges of our world, then I believe you.

timeline.summary: Tishana animates a jade totem into an elemental mount.
timeline.quote: began to form the shape of an elemental

timeline.summary: Huatli sends Inti and Teyeuh after a fleeing vampire.
timeline.quote: Inti, tail them!

timeline.summary: Tishana spots an illusion on the river water, which she judges beyond the vampires' mastery.
timeline.quote: Someone is casting an illusion there, on the water.

timeline.summary: Tishana and Huatli resolve to take the compass from the illusionist's boat, and Tishana admits even the River Heralds do not know where Orazca is.
timeline.quote: We need their compass more than we need them dead

timeline.summary: Vraska steers the boat toward the bank as the river narrows, and the two planeswalkers camp in the boat for the night.
timeline.quote: We'll sleep in the boat,

timeline.summary: Jace conjures a glowing illusory draft horse as a beacon for Malcolm and the crew.
timeline.quote: A large draft horse materialized above them, glowing a delicate blue against the night sky, and ran upward into the canopy.

timeline.summary: Vraska sings a Golgari song and talks with Jace before he falls asleep.
timeline.quote: The Golgari have little to be cheery about.

timeline.summary: Vraska decides she can trust Jace, possibly wants more than friendship, and resolves to petrify whoever stole his memories.
timeline.quote: Vraska knew in that moment that, memory or no, this was a man she could trust

timeline.summary: Vraska resolves to petrify whoever stole Jace's memories.
timeline.quote: Vraska couldn't wait to petrify whoever had stolen his memories.

timeline.summary: They abandon the boat and hack through the jungle, finding a dinosaur-made path.
timeline.quote: Vraska and Jace abandoned their boat the next morning.

timeline.summary: A vampire conquistador ambushes them under a cloud of dark smoke.
timeline.quote: A thick cloud of dark smoke suddenly flooded the grove around them.

timeline.summary: Jace dispels the darkness spell and Vraska fights the exposed vampire while Jace conjures an illusory storm.
timeline.quote: The dark smoke dissipated, leaving a conquistador standing exposed.

timeline.summary: The vampire knocks Jace down and steals the thaumatic compass, fleeing into the jungle.
timeline.quote: snagging the thaumatic compass from the ground at Jace's feet

timeline.summary: Jace goes to track the vampire but hears the minds of Tishana and Huatli pursuing it.
timeline.quote: What he heard instead was a pair of furious internal monologues.

timeline.summary: Tishana's illusory flying snake crashes into Jace's psychic defense.
timeline.quote: An immense, illusory, flying snake crashed into his arms and split on either side of Jace's psychic defense.

timeline.summary: Tishana snares Jace with vines, breaking his illusion.
timeline.quote: vines whipped up from the forest floor to wrap themselves around Jace's legs.

timeline.summary: Tishana and Huatli introduce themselves and Tishana demands the compass or their deaths.
timeline.quote: Hand over the compass or die where you stand.

timeline.summary: Jace tells them the vampire took the compass, and Tishana and Huatli leave to hunt it.
timeline.quote: The vampire took the compass from us.

timeline.summary: Huatli and her dinosaur hunt the vampire for nine hours.
timeline.quote: It took nine hours.

timeline.summary: Huatli's dinosaur seizes and shakes the vampire until the compass falls out, then Huatli lets it go and leaves the vampire to a raptor.
timeline.quote: An odd-looking compass flung out of her pocket and hit the ground.

timeline.summary: Tishana examines the compass, which lights and shows Orazca is half a day away.
timeline.quote: The end of our peregrination is near.

timeline.summary: Tishana betrays Huatli as the Belligerent crew ambushes them and Amelia binds Huatli in canvas.
timeline.quote: the slap of a large flap of canvas covering her face and knocking her off her mount

timeline.summary: Vraska petrifies Huatli's clawfoot and retakes the compass.
timeline.quote: Her clawfoot was in front of her, crouching for an attack, jaws wide open . . . and entirely encased in stone.

timeline.summary: Vraska explains how the crew caught up, using Malcolm in the sky and Jace's telepathy.
timeline.quote: It's much easier to find shortcuts with an eye in the sky and a telepath on the ground.

timeline.summary: Huatli summons clawfoots that scatter the pirates, and Tishana conjures a flood against the fleeing crew.
timeline.quote: she summoned a flood to careen through the jungle

timeline.summary: Tishana abandons Huatli to stop Kumena alone, breaking their bond.
timeline.quote: I must stop Kumena on my own.

timeline.summary: Angrath appears and chases Huatli, entangling her with a chain.
timeline.quote: a chain whacked and wrapped around her ankle, yanking Huatli to the forest floor.

timeline.summary: Angrath says he will not harm Huatli, and proposes they escape together by finding the city.
timeline.quote: Whatever prevents us from leaving this plane is locked in that city.

timeline.summary: Angrath adds that they must kill everyone who tries to steal Orazca.
timeline.quote: And all we have to do is kill everyone who tries to steal Orazca from our grasp.

timeline.summary: The compass vibrates and Malcolm sees the city ahead as the crew runs through the fog and mountains.
timeline.quote: It's on the hills ahead!

timeline.summary: The crew sees the spires of Orazca.
timeline.quote: Shining as golden beacons above the green, the spires of Orazca pierced the sky.

timeline.summary: Vraska and Jace discuss what the Immortal Sun might do, joking about Lord Nicolas.
timeline.quote: Maybe Lord Nicolas is a rock collector?

timeline.summary: Kumena nears Orazca using little magic to avoid Tishana.
timeline.quote: He was nearing the golden city of Orazca, the resting place of the Immortal Sun.

timeline.summary: Vraska is hit by an image of a broken white brick barrier at a harbor on a plane she has never visited.
timeline.quote: There was a massive barrier made of white brick against a turbulent sky.

timeline.summary: Huatli and Angrath watch Orazca rise from the valley.
timeline.quote: They watched as the golden spires of Orazca climbed higher and higher above the canopy of the valley below.

timeline.summary: Huatli finds the real city unlike the one in her vision.
timeline.quote: The city was more beautiful than she could possibly have imagined . . . and it looked nothing like the city she had seen in her vision.

timeline.summary: Huatli tells Angrath her emperor sent her to find Orazca.
timeline.quote: My emperor tasked me with this.

timeline.summary: Angrath calls every group on Ixalan ants on an anthill.
timeline.quote: The Sun Empire are ants on an anthill, and so are the River Heralds and so is Torrezon and so is every other group of idiots on this plane.

timeline.summary: Angrath leads Huatli into the Blind Eternities-like space between planes by planeswalking.
timeline.quote: Her perception wavered, and she leaned forward into a separate realm.

timeline.summary: Huatli looks through Angrath's portal at a snowy mountain plane and is yanked back by the barrier.
timeline.quote: Huatli tore through space and color and back through the fabric of existence

timeline.summary: Angrath names the plane they saw as Kaldheim and explains freedom starts with knowing you are trapped.
timeline.quote: Kaldheim,

timeline.summary: Angrath says they must be near whatever keeps them locked on the plane.
timeline.quote: We must be near whatever is keeping us locked on this plane,

timeline.summary: Angrath reveals he wants to see his daughters, whom he has not seen in fourteen years.
timeline.quote: I want to see my daughters

timeline.summary: Huatli and Angrath find a bat-marked tomb near Orazca and Huatli recalls the legend of the Bat of the East.
timeline.quote: There's a legend that says the bat of the East met Aclazotz

timeline.summary: A pale hand slides the tomb door aside and Saint Elenda emerges.
timeline.quote: a pale white hand reached out from the interior.

timeline.summary: Angrath identifies the vampire as Saint Elenda.
timeline.quote: You are Saint Elenda,

timeline.summary: Saint Elenda says Orazca has awoken at last.
timeline.quote: Orazca has awoken at last.

timeline.summary: Huatli threatens Elenda, refusing to let the Legion of Dusk take the city.
timeline.quote: I refuse to allow the Legion of Dusk to take the city.

timeline.summary: Elenda says she came only to retrieve what was hers and leave the rest in peace.
timeline.quote: To retrieve the one thing that is ours,

timeline.summary: Elenda laments that the Church turned her ritual into invasion.
timeline.quote: I left the Church with the knowledge of the ritual to take on my burden

timeline.summary: Saint Elenda vows to teach the Legion of Dusk what they forgot and vanishes through a dark slice in the air.
timeline.quote: She stepped forward, past Huatli and Angrath, and vanished into a dark slice in the air.

timeline.summary: Angrath attacks Huatli with a chain, then runs ahead to Orazca.
timeline.quote: Angrath launched a chain at Huatli's face that she just barely dodged, its heat searing her cheek.

timeline.summary: Huatli resolves to beat Angrath to Orazca.
timeline.quote: was going to get there before she did.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes the memory of Ugin hides a spell that compelled him to planeswalk to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: a clever bit of obfuscating mental magic that the spirit dragon must have implanted without him noticing.

timeline.summary: Huatli's summoned dinosaur bowls Angrath over and pins him.
timeline.quote: then effortlessly bowled him over and trapped him underfoot.

timeline.summary: Tishana arrives with her clan and confirms her agreement with Huatli stands.
timeline.quote: I assembled my clan. Our agreement stands.

timeline.summary: Huatli leaves Angrath under the dinosaur and goes with Tishana.
timeline.quote: Angrath, I'm sorry, but I need to go with Tishana. We had a deal first.

timeline.summary: Azor gifts the Immortal Sun to a monastery and then to the Sun Empire, reclaiming it each time.
timeline.quote: He gifted the Immortal Sun to a monastery that would later give rise to the Legion of Dusk

timeline.summary: The Immortal Sun is pulled away and Vraska planeswalks off Ixalan.
timeline.quote: As the portal closed, Vraska planeswalked away.

timeline.summary: Tishana declares Orazca found and Ixalan at peace.
timeline.quote: Orazca is found

timeline.summary: Vivien, aboard Frederic's ship, refuses to stow the Arkbow and expresses concern over the brontodon captive.
timeline.quote: There will be medical attention waiting for the brontodon, I hope?

timeline.summary: A branch of Realmbreaker splits the sky over the Sun Coast and Phyrexians invade Ixalan.
timeline.quote: revealing a hideous, colossal metal branch of Realmbreaker, the Invasion Tree

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians end the emperor's war and the Threefold Sun does not rise again.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians came to Ixalan and ended the emperor's war in its cradle.

timeline.summary: Vraska recalls singing with Jace on a boat on Ixalan.
timeline.quote: It is night on Ixalan, and I sing to the vast and buzzing jungle.

timeline.summary: Quint planeswalks to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: As Quint planeswalked from a dimly lit stone corridor into leaf-dappled sunshine, the heat slapped him like a moist towel.

timeline.summary: Three dinosaurs corner Quint in the jungle.
timeline.quote: He looked up and found himself dangerously close to an open mouth full of curved pointy teeth.

timeline.summary: Wayta calls off the dinosaurs, rescuing Quint, and introduces herself.
timeline.quote: With the flick of a hand, she dismissed the others as if they were trained pets, and they disappeared into the jungle.

timeline.summary: Amalia has a vision of sand, fire and a golden door, and a voice calls her; Clavileño wakes her before she falls from her saddle.
timeline.quote: Amalia bolted upright in her saddle, her arm aching as if she'd been pushed.

timeline.summary: Amalia notes the expedition's goal of finding a Temple of Aclazotz and a door that may end the Church of Dusk's schism.
timeline.quote: A Temple of Aclazotz supposedly awaited them in the depths of this continent.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Wayta recalls fighting the Phyrexian invasion, sailing with the Brazen Coalition and finally returning to the Sun Empire to join Huatli's expedition.
timeline.quote: She'd left the pirates and returned to the Sun Empire a year older

timeline.summary: Quint tastes a fragment from a pile of broken pottery and identifies it as bone.
timeline.quote: He picked something up with his trunk and touched it to his tongue.

timeline.summary: The expedition finds a chasm of glowing green fog crossed by glyph-marked stones.
timeline.quote: Caparocti dropped a pebble into the fog.

timeline.summary: Wayta deduces the stone path from the poem and sets out across the chasm.
timeline.quote: Let me try, Warrior-Poet.

timeline.summary: Wayta steps on a wrong stone, it falls, and the platforms begin to rearrange.
timeline.quote: Without warning, it fell into the fog.

timeline.summary: Caparocti hauls Wayta to safety and crosses with her.
timeline.quote: Strong hands grabbed her arms and hauled her up.

timeline.summary: Wayta touches the glyph panel in the poem's order, and the platforms form a solid bridge.
timeline.quote: The platforms slid together, forming a solid bridge, much easier to cross.

timeline.summary: Caparocti tells Wayta he is sure war with the Dusk Legion is coming and that the colonizers must be eliminated.
timeline.quote: The colonizers must be eliminated, or they will never stop trying to rule us.

timeline.summary: Vito sees a mosaic of Aclazotz and reflects on Bartolomé and Amalia, whom he suspects of hearing Aclazotz's call.
timeline.quote: Was she, too, hearing Aclazotz calling to her?

timeline.summary: Vito resolves that he alone is Aclazotz's instrument and will bring the god to Alta Torrezon.
timeline.quote: He would prove himself worthy by bringing Aclazotz to Alta Torrezon, ending the tiresome theological debates that plagued his people.

timeline.summary: Vito sacrifices another servant on an altar to open a second door.
timeline.quote: Clavileño and another soldier held the servant down as Vito cut his throat

timeline.summary: The door opens onto a vast underground desert of treacherous sand.
timeline.quote: now instead Vito faced a massive underground desert

timeline.summary: A scout is swallowed by the sand and vanishes.
timeline.quote: Without warning, too fast to make a sound, he vanished.

timeline.summary: Clavileño flies over the desert marking solid ground and the soldiers build a makeshift plank bridge.
timeline.quote: Clavileño's legs dissolved into smoke as he rose into the air.

timeline.summary: Mantis-spider creatures attack the column, seizing and devouring a porter and a prisoner.
timeline.quote: Their arms snapped out, snagging a porter and a prisoner, dragging them away as they screamed and flailed.

timeline.summary: Vito orders the vampires to purge the creatures; Amalia freezes one with magic and Bartolomé beheads another with his whip.
timeline.quote: Bartolomé unfurled a whip and lashed out, wrapping it around the monster's neck.

timeline.summary: The expedition tallies its losses on reaching the far side of the desert.
timeline.quote: They reported that beyond the two taken by the monsters, a porter, a soldier, two prisoners, and a horse had fallen into the sand.

timeline.summary: Vito privately resolves to eliminate Bartolomé if he hinders the mission.
timeline.quote: If Bartolomé tried to hinder the mission, he would be eliminated.

timeline.summary: Quint beholds a huge underground fungus-covered stone city, reminiscent of Zantafar.
timeline.quote: Before him stretched a cavern many miles across, from edge to edge filled with stone buildings and narrow streets.

timeline.summary: Quint finds a purple-pink poncho and beads in a plaza and uses the spell The Rousing on it.
timeline.quote: Quint finally found a pile of cloth and beads, surprisingly well preserved.

timeline.summary: The spell summons the ghost of an old man who has forgotten his name.
timeline.quote: The poncho rose, hovering in the air.

timeline.summary: The ghost cries that it must warn Oteclan of a mycoid infestation and that the door must be closed, then runs off.
timeline.quote: I must warn Oteclan of the mycoid infestation. It's too late. The door must be closed!

timeline.summary: Amalia and the expedition reach a cavern with a lava waterfall and a deserted-looking settlement.
timeline.quote: a thunderous fall of lava cascaded down the side of a wall, bright enough to light the entire space

timeline.summary: A strange swordsman runs toward the vampires, pursued by pale goblin-like creatures.
timeline.quote: Someone emerged from a nearby building, chased by a half-dozen smaller figures.

timeline.summary: Amalia alters her map with her enchanted quill, removing part of the bridge so the pursuers fall.
timeline.quote: With a delicate scratch of her quill, Amalia changed the map, and changed the world.

timeline.summary: The rescued man introduces himself as Kellan, from Eldraine.
timeline.quote: I'm Kellan

timeline.summary: Vito refuses to help Kellan, but Amalia takes responsibility for him and Vito grudgingly accepts.
timeline.quote: I'll take responsibility for him.

timeline.summary: Bartolomé warns Amalia not to defy Vito openly again.
timeline.quote: Do not openly defy him again

timeline.summary: Abuelo cries 'Titan!' and vanishes as Wayta and Quint chase him by an underground river.
timeline.quote: then vanished in a swirl of purple-pink energy

timeline.summary: A huge mushroom-headed titan appears and charges Wayta and Quint.
timeline.quote: Ahead, a hulking figure loomed, easily twice her height.

timeline.summary: The titan hurls a chunk of wall at Wayta, who dodges and fights it alone.
timeline.quote: The titan grabbed half of a crumbling wall and threw it at Wayta.

timeline.summary: Huatli, Inti, Caparocti and the other warriors arrive and attack the titan.
timeline.quote: Huatli, Inti, Caparocti, and the other warriors had arrived while Wayta was fighting

timeline.summary: The titan heals its wounds with fungus, kills warriors and spits corrosive black fluid; one warrior dies despite Wayta's attempt to help.
timeline.quote: the sight of bloody bone through the remains of the man's flesh told her she was too late.

timeline.summary: A dozen smaller mushroom creatures surround the Sun Empire party.
timeline.quote: A dozen new creatures surrounded them

timeline.summary: River Heralds burst out of the river and join the battle, offering to take the party to safety.
timeline.quote: A wave lashed out of the underground river, knocking two of the creatures away.

timeline.summary: Quint summons an ancient weapon with a spell and impales a mushroom creature.
timeline.quote: An ancient weapon rose from the ground as if wielded by a spirit

timeline.summary: A Herald casts a breathing spell on Wayta and shoves her into the river.
timeline.quote: Swift travels, little sister

timeline.summary: Bartolomé reveals Queen Miralda secretly assigned him to learn Vito's true intentions and loyalties.
timeline.quote: When Queen Miralda assigned Bartolomé to join this expedition, he was told to play along and discover Vito's true intentions and loyalties.

timeline.summary: Two dozen catlike Malamet warriors surround the Legion.
timeline.quote: Two dozen warriors surrounded them, taller than the vampires, broader, with faces like great cats and spotted fur to match.

timeline.summary: Kutzil introduces herself and demands the Legion come with her.
timeline.quote: I am Kutzil, champion of the Malamet

timeline.summary: Vito quietly warns Bartolomé not to undermine him again.
timeline.quote: Do not undermine me again

timeline.summary: Wayta surfaces in an underground freshwater sea beside Quint.
timeline.quote: Wayta kicked her way to the surface, searching for the others

timeline.summary: Nicanzil welcomes the party to the River Heralds' city.
timeline.quote: I am Nicanzil

timeline.summary: Huatli wonders if the corroded door atop the temple is Matzalantli.
timeline.quote: Could this be Matzalantli?

timeline.summary: Wayta objects to Quint's plan to excavate and write up Ixalan's history for outsiders.
timeline.quote: You shouldn't be telling our stories for us.

timeline.summary: Trapped in the sand, Amalia has new visions of the round glyph door, a map-like sky and a burning sphere ringed with purple-pink debris.
timeline.quote: The mysterious door, round and covered in glyphs, clearer than before.

timeline.summary: The Legion falls out of the sand into the same freshwater sea.
timeline.quote: Without warning, she hit water, her eyes flying open.

timeline.summary: River Heralds surround and capture the Legion in the water.
timeline.quote: River Heralds, dozens, all armed with their strange jade weapons and elemental magics.

timeline.summary: The Mycotyrant announces it will assimilate Malcolm and Breeches and ascend to the surface.
timeline.quote: We will assimilate you, and we will ascend to the surface and its sun.

timeline.summary: Malcolm sings to stun the colony and leads Breeches toward a water tunnel.
timeline.quote: Taking a deep breath, Malcolm began to sing.

timeline.summary: The Mycotyrant breaks free of the song with a scream and the colony chases them.
timeline.quote: A hideous, many-mouthed scream echoed behind them.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Breeches burst out above a vast ocean and the River Heralds' city.
timeline.quote: Without warning, the tunnel ended in a short cliff.

timeline.summary: The Mycotyrant's forces, including infected Downtown residents, dinosaurs and bats, erupt after them.
timeline.quote: The Mycotyrant's forces erupted from the tunnel.

timeline.summary: Merfolk defend their city against the fungal invasion with elementals.
timeline.quote: Merfolk drew weapons, activated the enchantments in their armor, pulled out jade totems and summoned huge elemental creatures to repel the fungal invasion.

timeline.summary: Nicanzil confronts Malcolm and Breeches, then agrees the Core must be warned.
timeline.quote: I am Nicanzil. What evil have you brought to our shores?

timeline.summary: Saheeli stands alone on a beach on Ixalan's northern coast, mourning the loss of planeswalking.
timeline.quote: Saheeli stood on the white sand of some lonely strand of Ixalan's northern coast.

timeline.summary: Saheeli tries to planeswalk and finds nothing.
timeline.quote: She tried. Nothing.

timeline.summary: Huatli trains playfully with her new quetzacama companion Pantlaza in the surf.
timeline.quote: She turned to see Huatli and Pantlaza

timeline.summary: Huatli shares her own grief at the loss of her spark.
timeline.quote: With my spark, I felt whole

timeline.summary: Saheeli theorizes their sparks were moved, not destroyed.
timeline.quote: Our sparks were moved. Not destroyed

timeline.summary: Huatli proposes they explore Ixalan together the slow way.
timeline.quote: We can go together, the slow way, and find out.

timeline.summary: Saheeli sails seasick for nearly a week on a Brazen Coalition ship.
timeline.quote: The journey from Queen's Bay across the eastern ocean took nearly a week.

timeline.summary: Six months earlier, Vraska recruits Breeches and Malcolm in High and Dry.
timeline.quote: "Hello, boys. You sound like you need a job."

timeline.summary: The Survivor, last aberration, waits on a beach and has been hiding the plan from the Theorist.
timeline.quote: He's been concealing their machinations from the Theorist.

timeline.summary: The Survivor weighs his life by his deeds, choices and crimes, and is steeped in regret.
timeline.quote: He was ready to trade all of existence for the possibility of a future.

timeline.summary: Vraska sits beside the Survivor, who confesses he is afraid to die.
timeline.quote: "I'm afraid to die," he confesses.

timeline.summary: The Survivor declares that he does not want peace and that he is in progress.
timeline.quote: "I'm in progress."

timeline.summary: Vraska tells him she loves all of him, and he recites a Vrynian prayer of betrothal, asking her to be there for Tam.
timeline.quote: Encircle our union and bind our futures, pleasant and painful, spouse to spouse, marriage to death."

timeline.summary: Vraska offers to gift the Survivor a kind death, and he accepts before joining her.
timeline.quote: Let me at least gift you a kind death."

timeline.summary: The elder dinosaurs, including Ghalta, are freed from their stasis within Orazca.
timeline.quote: When the elder dinosaurs were freed from their stasis within Orazca, a truly titanic beast was released

timeline.summary: Huatli is trapped on her home plane for many years by a magical artifact.
timeline.quote: After spending many years trapped on her home plane by a magical artifact

timeline.summary: The Immortal Sun passes from legend to reality and all the peoples of Ixalan seek its power.
timeline.quote: now legend has become reality, and all the peoples of Ixalan seek the Immortal Sun and the power it promises.

timeline.summary: The pirates of the Brazen Coalition and then the Legion of Dusk disrupt the balance between the merfolk and humans.
timeline.quote: But outsiders—first the treasure-hungry pirates of the Brazen Coalition and now the sinister fleets of the Legion of Dusk—have disrupted that delicate balance of power.

timeline.summary: As the Legion of Dusk seeks to conquer Ixalan, all four peoples search desperately for the golden city.
timeline.quote: And as the Legion of Dusk seeks to conquer Ixalan, all four peoples are catapulted into a desperate search for the golden city and the treasure it holds.

relations.note: the forgotten city on the continent Vraska was sent to
relations.quote: He told me to make for the continent of Ixalan.
